rationale: Envelope schema version pin; validate_snapshot rejects any other version. Protocol constant; changing it alters the accepted wire contract.
Input structural caps (depth 32, nodes/array/object 10000, 1 MiB) are DoS bounds; a registry value strictly <= code ceiling only narrows, raise never allowed. Low value; ceiling must stay in code.
2**53 is the binary64 exact-integer limit; guards silent rounding before policy comparison. Numeric-correctness invariant, not policy.
Validates the issuer-supplied snapshot field effective_max_effects (>=1 exact int). Value is issuer/claim-bound; the host-side max_effects ceiling is a separate governed param (f1abc).
allowed_institutions set is narrowed by authenticated Registry f1a/f1abc selection (intersection, subset re-check) on current main; the check() deny evaluator stays in code.
Renewal accepted only from the issuer recorded at admission; authority-binding rule, any relaxation widens authority.
Pins the synthetic refund intent profile's single effect class into the intent key; identity/profile constant, one permitted value, no variation.
Binds intent to institution, domain, customer and the two refund action ids; scope-identity binding for destination ownership, widening would break ownership. Synthetic profile.
Plumbing that forwards host-set opt-in profiles onto the per-call workflow view so policy digests are enforced; omission would skip checks. No value.
Carries the host freshness reaper onto the per-call view so a dead reaper refuses before dispatch; fail-closed propagation mechanism.
docker/cpu 1/memory 256Mi accepted only as the single qualified synthetic profile; one value, no permitted variation, variation is out of qualification.
Gateway acceptance pins version 0.1.2, healthy, localhost, docker driver; environment attestation check guarding dispatch.
Closed event-kind vocabulary for the append-only evidence log; changing it changes evidence semantics.
Equality check that an existing shared budget row matches the claim max_effects; evidence-integrity/anti-tamper, not a limit value.
Enforces the claim not_before<=now<expires_at; interval values come from the issuer/grant, check is the validity evaluator.
Atomic budget exhaustion check (used>=max, max==claim.max_effects) at execution; core enforcement algorithm.
Closeout requires exactly one retained attempt identity before recording; evidence-integrity identity check.
Gate evaluator: tool not in frame allowed list escalates. Lists are caller/frame-owned; fixed result and rule ordering are the enforcement algorithm.
Resolves a rule to adopted/unknown from signed revisions and observed digest; never silently adopted. Adoption/evidence evaluator.
Closed set of manifest versions the validator implements (E016); capability of code, not policy.
Duplicate action/tool name rejection (E004/E005); structural integrity of the manifest.
default_action is a manifest/action-level field authored in the manifest (block narrows); the validator fallback 'escalate' is fail-safe and E020-E022 tighten non-block. Not a registry param.
Single implemented classifier semantics (precedence, exact-match, future rejection); verifier refuses any other declared semantics. Evaluator logic.
Refuses naive datetimes rather than reading them as UTC; time-correctness invariant.
Closed enum of evidence kinds used to validate authority-context obligations (bounded.py:2538); protocol vocabulary.
Closed enum of unknown_behavior values; each maps to coded handling (e.g. hold_effect). Mandatory vocabulary.
Pydantic evidence record shapes, phase/stage literals and reason-vocabulary label default; serialization/evidence format.

Monotone input-time floor algorithm (regression detection, future stamps cannot poison floor). tolerance_seconds is a caller param fed from host clock_tolerance_seconds (default 5); not a literal here.
Recovery algorithm closing dead-lease checks and flagging overdue ones; deadlines come from freshness profile. Enforcement mechanism.
Pure accessors for opt-in RuntimeAuthorityProfile members; no value or rule. Profile content is host-supplied trusted configuration.
Merge fold is authority-bearing: requires enabled profiles, funded authority and an adopted equivalence-rule digest signed by non-reviser. Authority path.
Cached-positive fallback permitted only for non-irreversible classes declared bounded_tolerance and no recorded denial; fail-closed algorithm; class flags are issuer-owned.
Reason strings and vocabulary label written to journal events; closed reason vocabulary (evidence).
Profile and reason-vocabulary version labels that vocabulary_for resolves against pinned schema files; protocol constants.
Typed evidence criterion kinds and members list cap in a signed/validated schema; schema bound, not operator policy.
Profile-composition validator: declared reversibility values require the reversibility profile; structural consistency.
Profile id, capability id and reason codes of freshness/0.1; closed protocol vocabulary. Tunables live in FreshnessProfile (host-owned), not here.
0.01s poll interval and flock mode are lock mechanism tuning; the policy value (lease_acquire_timeout_seconds) is already host profile config.
Protected-read or unobservable-counterparty defaults reversibility to irreversible (strictest). Fail-closed default floor; configuring could only weaken.
Claim-issuance evidence projection: required or hold_effect evidence must be current, exact-int age, not future, not stale. max_age comes from the issuer requirement; rule is the evaluator.
Validity interval is intersection (max not_before, min expires_at) of grant, proposal, request; must be non-empty and future. Pure narrowing algorithm.
Validator enforces provider_horizon <= escalation_deadline < dedupe_ttl; consistency invariant. The three values are host/provider-owned profile fields, not literals.
HMAC-SHA256 replay-bundle integrity; verify rejects other algorithms. Signing/evidence-integrity mechanism with caller-held secret.
Redaction mechanism is fixed; the flags (RedactionConfig) are per-invocation caller choices on an exported copy. No authority; fingerprint blanking default is privacy-safe.
Envelope version, verdict source, does_not_prove disclaimers, outcome map and exit codes are output protocol constants; disclaimers are honesty statements.
